newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GPG lifts offer for Ballarat Brewing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GPG lifts offer for Ballarat Brewing.

text.p: Guiness Peat Group Plc (GPG) said on Friday it had lifted its cash takeover offer for tourism and leisure group Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd to A$2.50 from A$2.45 and had extended the offer period to February 6, 1997.
The company said the offer included Ballarat Brewing's four cent interim dividend, effectively raising the total consideration to A$2.54 per share.
Ballarat Brewing is also the subject of a takeover by Australia's largest brewer, Foster's Brewing Group Ltd, whose subsidiary Carlton and United Breweries (CUB) is bidding A$2.50 cash per share.
Foster's is already the largest shareholder in Ballarat Brewing with a 42.4 percent stake.

"The current offer by CUB provides that shareholders who accept the CUB offer will not be entitled to retain the four cents interim dividend. Accordingly, the revised GPG offer is effectively four cents per share higher than the CUB offer," GPG said in a statement.
Last month Ballarat Brewing independent directors rejected the Foster's bid, citing a report from independent expert Grant Samuel which valued Ballarat shares at A$2.56 to A$2.93 each.
A spokesman for Ballarat said the company would respond to the latest offer from GPG on Monday.
Ballarat shares last traded at A$2.59 on January 2.
